skill.name: document-generation
skill.description: Generate Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files from structured content, and extract text from PDFs.
skill.summary: Create common office documents and extract PDF text through reusable Python generators.
skill.author: BOHUYESHAN-APB

security_audit.summary: Eleven static alerts are false positives caused by normal output-directory handling, temporary-file cleanup, CSS, comments, and Markdown backticks. Two network alerts are confirmed because image sources can trigger unrestricted HTTP requests. Additional review found output path traversal, local image disclosure, and external resource loading through PDF rendering.

remediation.issue: Caller-supplied filenames can escape configured output directories.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths, reduce filenames to safe basenames, and verify each resolved output path remains inside the configured directory.

remediation.issue: Image URLs can access internal services or download excessive content.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only approved HTTPS hosts, block private and link-local addresses, stream responses with size limits, and set connect and read timeouts.

remediation.issue: Local image paths can expose files outside an approved asset directory.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit local asset access and verify resolved image paths remain inside a dedicated trusted directory.

remediation.issue: WeasyPrint can resolve external resources referenced by supplied HTML.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a restrictive URL fetcher that denies network and file resources unless they match an explicit allowlist.

semantic_findings.title: Output Filename Path Traversal
semantic_findings.description: Generators join caller-supplied filenames to output directories without rejecting absolute paths or parent segments, allowing generated files to overwrite writable paths elsewhere.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Each generator writes to a direct join of its output directory and an unvalidated filename. Pathlib and os.path joins accept parent segments, and absolute names can replace the base path.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted Local Image Inclusion
semantic_findings.description: Supplied HTML can reference any accessible local image path, causing its contents to be embedded in generated Word or PowerPoint files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both generators test supplied image sources with os.path.exists and pass matching paths directly to document image APIs. No trusted asset root or access check is applied.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted PDF External Resource Loading
semantic_findings.description: Supplied HTML is rendered by WeasyPrint without a restrictive resource fetcher, allowing absolute remote or local resources to be requested during PDF generation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The renderer receives supplied HTML directly and uses its default URL fetcher. Absolute resource references are not filtered before rendering.

content.user_title: Create Office Documents from Structured Content
content.value_statement: Creating consistent office files manually takes time. This skill generates Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files and extracts text from PDFs.
actual_capabilities: Generate Word documents from HTML with headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, inline styles, and images.
Build PowerPoint presentations from HTML sections with themed slides, text, images, tables, and basic charts.
Create Excel workbooks from lists of row dictionaries using pandas.
Render HTML or plain text as PDF files with basic document styling.
Extract page text from PDF files and convert Markdown into HTML.
limitations: Document extraction is implemented only for PDF files.
The generators require Python libraries that are not installed by this skill.
PowerPoint layouts use fixed dimensions and may need manual adjustment for dense content.
Remote and local image sources require security controls before processing untrusted content.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Reports
use_cases.description: Turn approved HTML content into branded Word or PDF reports for review and distribution.

use_cases.title: Build Presentation Drafts
use_cases.description: Convert structured slide sections into a PowerPoint draft with tables, charts, and supporting images.

use_cases.title: Export Operational Data
use_cases.description: Write lists of business records to an Excel workbook for analysis or sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Word report named [filename] with a title, introduction, three sections, bullet points, and a conclusion using this content: [content].
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a basic document from prepared notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PowerPoint named [filename] with [slide count] slides from [content]. Include concise titles, supporting points, and tables where relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Export Records to Excel
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excel workbook named [filename] from these records: [records]. Preserve field names as columns and keep one record per row.
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert structured business data into a spreadsheet.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Multi-Format Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate Word, PDF, and PowerPoint versions of [content]. Use consistent section names, adapt layouts by format, and report every output path.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create coordinated deliverables for several audiences.

output_examples.input: Create a Word project update with progress, risks, next steps, and a two-column milestone table.
output_examples.output: A Word document containing a project title, three concise sections, bullet lists, and a formatted milestone table.

output_examples.input: Build a six-slide quarterly review from the supplied HTML sections and sales table.
output_examples.output: A PowerPoint presentation with six titled slides, summarized text, and a chart derived from the sales table.

output_examples.input: Extract all readable text from the uploaded PDF.
output_examples.output: Page text returned in reading order, separated with blank lines between extracted pages.

best_practices: Use simple filenames and keep every output inside a dedicated document directory.
Provide concise, structured HTML with clear headings and moderate content per slide.
Review generated files for layout, image quality, and sensitive information before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not process untrusted image URLs or local paths without validation.
Do not use parent directory segments or absolute paths in output filenames.
Do not assume Word, PowerPoint, or Excel extraction is available.

faq.question: Which file formats can this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and PDF files.

faq.question: Can it extract content from every supported format?
faq.answer: No. The included processor extracts text from PDF files only.

faq.question: What input creates Word and PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: Both generators accept HTML. PowerPoint treats selected sections or slide classes as individual slides.

faq.question: Can it include images?
faq.answer: Yes. Word and PowerPoint support local or remote images, but sources should be validated before use.

faq.question: Does the skill install its dependencies?
faq.answer: No. Required document, rendering, parsing, and spreadsheet libraries must already be available.

faq.question: Does it preserve complex source layouts?
faq.answer: No. It creates documents from supported structures and basic styles, so complex layouts may require manual refinement.
